title: Static QA temporal and semantic coverage gap audit
material_new_evidence: Batch145 224/224 evidence declares itself a static preflight and explicitly records runtime_executed=false.
The static QA is bound to historical pre-head a5015ec18565fff8721c940d33520759687782a7, while the fresh canonical head is 5423a8efed435453eeda14c0a49338b522330e43.
The static QA records coordinator request blob cfc9819ea2bad64a30535df8c360fc6702055b06, while the current request blob is 27796bab6c167d886af0bda31dc6eb44f9d6e594.

Its twelve guard groups and seven assertion groups do not cover the 045-to-039 heartbeat key parity, explicit slot heartbeat freshness, resume078 embedded semantics, ownership business-write prohibition, or presence of the nine critical runtime/materialization outputs.
A replacement QA must be current-head bound and include semantic producer/consumer and embedded-pin checks before 224/224 can be treated as current readiness evidence.
